Blood glucose management

HbA1c measurement and targets

Measure HbA1c levels in adults with type 2 diabetes every 3 to 6 months.

Support adults to aim for an HbA1c level of 48 mmol/mol (6.5%) or lower.

Metformin dosing

Metformin should be dose-reduced when eGFR falls to 30-44 mL/min/1.73 m2.

  • Discontinue metformin below eGFR 30 mL/min/1.73 m2.
  • Review renal function annually.
  • ask if they are having problems using their­device

Support adults with type 2 diabetes to monitor their condition.
